record.paper_title: Nicholson's blowflies differential equations revisited: Main results and open problems
record.original_question: Analyze Nicholson-type population models with nonlinear density-dependent mortality. Specifically, replace the linear mortality term in the Nicholson model by a nonlinear mortality function D(x) and study dx/dt = -D(x) + P x(t-s) exp(-x(t-s)), where P is the egg-production parameter, s is the maturation delay, and D may take forms such as D(x) = a x/(x+b) or D(x) = a - b exp(-x) with positive constants a and b. Determine the qualitative dynamics relevant to such fishery models, including the behavior created by these nonlinear mortality terms.

evidence.quote: Consider a Nicholson's model with a nonlinear density-dependent mortality term
where function D might have one of the following forms: D(x) = ax/(x + b) or D(x) = a - be-x with positive constants a, b > 0.

artifact.status_search_result: Many partial results are available: permanence, global asymptotic stability under various sufficient conditions, existence and exponential stability of (almost) periodic solutions, and Hopf bifurcation/chaos as the delay grows have been established in several works for Nicholson's blowflies models with nonlinear density-dependent mortality of the forms D(x)=ax/(x+b) and D(x)=a-b e^{-x}. However, a complete qualitative classification (sharp global stability thresholds, full bifurcation picture) remains open.

status_evidence.title: Hopf bifurcation and chaos in a delayed Nicholson's blowflies equation with nonlinear density-dependent mortality rate
status_evidence.snippet: As delay increases, the system undergoes sequences of Hopf bifurcations and exhibits chaos.
status_evidence.claim: Bifurcation/chaos behaviour with nonlinear mortality has been partially characterized.

status_evidence.title: Permanence for a delayed Nicholson's blowflies model with a nonlinear density-dependent mortality term
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions for permanence of the delayed Nicholson model with nonlinear mortality.

status_evidence.title: Global asymptotic stability for a nonlinear density-dependent mortality Nicholson's blowflies system involving multiple pairs of time-varying delays
status_evidence.snippet: Sufficient conditions ensuring global asymptotic stability via fluctuation lemma and differential inequalities.
status_evidence.claim: Partial global stability results have been obtained.

status_evidence.title: Almost periodic solutions for a delayed Nicholson's blowflies model with a nonlinear density-dependent mortality term
status_evidence.snippet: Existence and exponential stability of positive almost periodic solutions.
